draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.00, the 124th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 9th of 19 at RB. He lasted until pick 211, well after his grade rank (124th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Theo Riddick. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (16th percentile), 20-yard shuttle (13th percentile). College production: 668 rushing yards in 2020, 12th of 19 RBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2022. 24 career games and 4 starts over 2 completed seasons. Career-best season: 2 AV in 2021. Weak spots: team carry share 0.5% (0th percentile), scrimmage yards 4 (2nd percentile). Played 8 of 17 games in 2022.
